messages.content: Extract the query keywords and concepts needed to identify relevant graph entities. Use only concepts explicitly expressed in the query. Do not answer the query or add facts. Return strict JSON with exactly one key, keywords, containing a list of strings.

Which papers satisfy these requirements: the abstract explicitly includes at least one of “we present an exact solution” or “in excellent agreement with experimental” (case-insensitive); and at least one author is affiliated with Shahjalal University of Science and Technology?

raw: {"keywords":["abstract includes \"we present an exact solution\" (case-insensitive)","abstract includes \"in excellent agreement with experimental\" (case-insensitive)","author affiliation Shahjalal University of Science and Technology"]}
